race.comment: MINATO (5) won her maiden here last season, and resumed with an encouraging third on this track 3 weeks ago over 1000m. The extra 210m is ideal, and despite a tricky gate, she combines with Rochelle Milnes again, so stick with her on top. LAKE AGAWAM (8) was a beaten favourite fresh up in the same race as the top pick, finishing fifth, after getting a long way back early on. His hand may be forced again from a wide gate, but the extra distance, means he could have the last say this time. Follow your money. BENDING AWAY (7) was beaten by a wide draw, and needed the run when finishing midfield in the same race as the top 2 picks. She has shown that she can be quite capable on her day, and she is worth including in all combos here. KUBLAI (3) resumes from a spell, and has yet to miss a cheque in 4 starts here over the trip, including a win. Keep him safe. CHAMPAGNE EFFORT (10) led up and was only bloused right on the line when finishing runner-up by a nose here 3 weeks ago. Go again.
